instruction: Can you enable the VLC background cone logo in VLC Media Player? I actually like seeing the iconic orange traffic cone when no media is playing - it's a nice visual element.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling the VLC background cone logo (opposite of variation 0). The evaluator uses the existing check_qt_bgcone metric to verify that qt-bgcone is set to 1 (enabled, which is the default). Similar difficulty to variation 0 but with opposite goal.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads VLC configuration file from appropriate OS-specific paths
Metric correctly checks qt-bgcone setting with proper default value handling (defaults to '1' if not explicitly set)
Expected value of 1 semantically correct for enabling the background cone logo
Postconfig properly kills and restarts VLC to ensure settings are persisted to disk
Complete coverage of instruction requirement (enable background cone)
Proper type conversion handling (int to string) in metric comparison
